criteria.given: The two requested demonstration-note paths are inspected
then: They contain matching ordered section identifiers and session outcomes

criteria.given: A technical presenter has the rebuilt guide
criteria.when: They scan the document from beginning to end
then: The guide presents an opening, core model, lifecycle walkthrough, evidence and recovery, adoption exercise, and close

criteria.given: A presenter is preparing to run one guide section
then: They can find a concise cue card
They can find an observable audience outcome

criteria.given: The guide describes a demonstration, example, or result
criteria.when: The claim is checked against the repository
then: The material is labeled live, saved evidence, or optional
Unverified execution is not presented as fact

criteria.given: The guide makes a workflow or evidence claim
then: The source supports the claim being made

criteria.given: The English and Persian guides are compared
criteria.when: Their structure and meaning are reviewed
then: They cover the same outcomes and lifecycle
Natural language differences do not change the intended meaning

criteria.given: The rebuilt guide is compared with the current 40-slide notes
criteria.when: A presenter evaluates scanability and scope
then: The rebuilt guide is materially shorter and easier to scan
The core AskIt model and safety boundaries remain present
